verdict.rationale: Honcho's open-source core can be self-hosted with its own Postgres via `honcho start`, so data can stay on your own infrastructure (honcho-docs-9, honcho-docs-10). Its CLI emits structured JSON (honcho-docs-13), which gives a plausible but undocumented path to getting data out. There is no documented export feature, so leaving with all of your data depends on owning the database rather than on an explicit portability tool. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of messages, peers, sessions and derived representations; a specified open export format; a documented migration-out path; independent or hands-on corroboration.
